claim_boundary: Exact finite reconciliation of the transported Green atomic register with the selected source-retained G1 carrier. Atomic defect P_j maps to source grade e_(p,j+1); grades one and two enter Gamma_12, grades at least three enter Gamma_>=3, and the finite terminal coordinate is retained as the highest current grade before any fibrewise codiagonal.
grade_map: P_j maps to e_(2,k) with k=j+1
constructor_order: form window and cut/Wronskian graph outputs
apply any all-prime scalar evaluator only terminally
terminal_policy: P_N is retained as grade k=N+1. Under cutoff extension it keeps that grade and ceases to be terminal; only the newly appended coordinate is terminal.

disposition.output_only_mate: not required by the selected architecture
disposition.cutoff_naturality: prefix grade coordinates and all existing graph outputs are unchanged
disposition.remaining_scope: this aligns the valuation register with G1; it does not establish G2-G4 or RH
